race.comment: FEARFUL (2) has been about the mark in recent runs and was good again at the latest appearance when he came from a wide barrier and finished a head away in third at Newcastle. That was his third placing from his last four outings. Should enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position so could break through. HELENS BOY (3) hasn't been far away from the placings here of late, racing three wide without cover when fourth last start. With better luck he has winning claims. KING COREY (8) draws wide but must be considered after he finished runner-up in his last three starts. VESPA STRIDE (6) is better suited back in grade and did manage back-to-back placings here last month.
